mundane_explanation.surviving: Control group analysis explicitly tested and excluded by-design heuristic hypothesis: (1) Error does NOT scale linearly with collection size (FAILED - 50:-13.3%, 200:+5%, 500:-10% non-linear), (2) Error direction is NOT consistent (FAILED - flips under/over/under), (3) Magnitude exceeds 10% tolerance in 2 of 3 cases. If this were a by-design fallback heuristic (e.g., 'estimate at 50% when uncertain'), error direction and magnitude would be consistent. The observed non-linear, direction-flipping pattern indicates a genuine estimator bug in index histogram calculation.
